glyph.isekai_mahou.infinity.desc: Mugen: for 10 s (Extend +5 s; 6 mana/s) everything that approaches slows down and STOPS 1.5 blocks from you; projectiles hang in mid-air and attacks are nullified. Only a Sure Hit pierces Infinity; bosses deal 25%.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lapse_blue.desc: Lapse: opens a violent point of attraction that sucks in creatures, items and projectiles, crushes whatever reaches the center and devours the terrain around it (with destruction on). With Self, it appears 6 blocks ahead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.reversal_red.desc: Reversal: a point of repulsion that bursts into a red wave, hurling everything far away with high damage and a small crater. With Self, it is fired forward.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dismantle.desc: An invisible, straight and long slash (24 blocks; Expand +50%) that slices creatures (Bleeding 3) and the terrain itself. Split: fanned slashes. Colossal: the world-cutting slash.
glyph.isekai_mahou.cleave.desc: A slash that adapts to its target: damage = 10 + 8% of max health (3% on bosses) + 1 per armor point, Bleeding 5, drawn as a grid of cuts over the body. With Self, cleaves the nearest enemy in front of you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.flame_arrow.desc: Open: a bow of flames forms in your hand and looses a blazing arrow that scorches the ground along its path and explodes into a giant pillar of fire with a crater (Burning 5).
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_shrine.desc: The Shrine rises behind you and the sky turns red. The domain becomes OPEN (no walls, cannot be broken) and 50% larger. Every half second the terrain is shredded by Dismantle and every enemy inside is Cleaved; the barriers of smaller closed domains are attacked from outside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.law_infinite_void.des: The inside of the domain becomes the cosmos. Infinite information paralyzes enemies: Stunned for the first 3 seconds, then for 1 s every 4 s, and Slowed the whole time.
legend.isekai_mahou.unlimited_void.desc: A closed Domain Expansion: inside is the cosmos, and infinite information keeps every enemy stunned and slowed while the Sure Hit lands.
legend.isekai_mahou.blue.desc: A fast projectile that opens a point of attraction on impact: pulls everything in, crushes it and tears up the terrain.
legend.isekai_mahou.red.desc: Repulsion fired from your fingertip: it flies straight and bursts into a red wave that hurls everything far away.
legend.isekai_mahou.infinity.desc: Mugen for 20 s: nothing can reach you — creatures stop 1.5 blocks away, projectiles hang in the air and attacks are nullified (except Sure Hit and bosses).
legend.isekai_mahou.fuga.desc: Open: the King of Curses' bow of flames. The arrow burns its path and becomes a pillar of fire with a crater.
A colossal Dismantle: a blade almost a hundred blocks long that slices mountains, buildings and everything in front of you.
effect.isekai_mahou.mugen.description: Mugen: the infinite space between you and the world. Nothing gets closer than 1.5 blocks; attacks and projectiles are nullified (except Sure Hit; bosses deal 25%). Drains 6 mana per second.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_c.infinity_: Out of mana: your Infinity fades.
The Sure Hit pierces your Infinity!
message.isekai_mahou.legends_c.void_over: Infinite information floods your mind... you cannot move!
